name: Epipolar Coordinate Integral Approximation
definition: Rewrites the scattering integral in epipolar coordinates (α, β, γ) to separate variables, allowing approximation of the integrand using Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to reduce computational cost from per-pixel to per-slice.
summary: Epipolar Coordinate Integral Approximation reduces volumetric shadowing cost by decomposing the integrand via SVD in epipolar coordinates, enabling massive parallelism through independent per-ray processing.
